requires: Patient Messages Content and Status headers
note fragment in the Content column below the headers
an aligned New status for the same saved row
success_contract.rejects: note text visible only in the unsaved entry form

oracle_adjudication.contract: The final screenshot must show a contiguous note fragment of at least 16 squashed characters inside a saved Patient Messages Content row aligned with its New status. Note text in the unsaved entry form is not saved-row evidence.
oracle_adjudication.old_behavior: The legacy verifier accepted the requested note anywhere in full-frame OCR and returned success for compiled run 20.
oracle_adjudication.new_behavior: The saved-row verifier rejects compiled run 20 because the note remains in the open textarea and the Save as new message button remains visible; no saved row contains the note.
